nodes.Name: Value
nodes.DocComment:
A Value can represent any Go value, but unlike type any,
it can represent most small values without an allocation.
The zero Value corresponds to nil.

nodes.Name: Kind
nodes.DocComment: Kind is the kind of a [Value].

nodes.Name: kind
nodes.DocComment:
Unexported version of Kind, just so we can store Kinds in Values.
(No user-provided value has this type.)

nodes.Name: Kind
nodes.DocComment: Kind returns v's Kind.

nodes.Name: StringValue
nodes.DocComment: StringValue returns a new [Value] for a string.

nodes.Name: IntValue
nodes.DocComment: IntValue returns a [Value] for an int.

nodes.Name: Int64Value
nodes.DocComment: Int64Value returns a [Value] for an int64.

nodes.Name: Uint64Value
nodes.DocComment: Uint64Value returns a [Value] for a uint64.

nodes.Name: Float64Value
nodes.DocComment: Float64Value returns a [Value] for a floating-point number.

nodes.Name: BoolValue
nodes.DocComment: BoolValue returns a [Value] for a bool.

nodes.Name: TimeValue
nodes.DocComment:
TimeValue returns a [Value] for a [time.Time].
It discards the monotonic portion.

nodes.Name: DurationValue
nodes.DocComment: DurationValue returns a [Value] for a [time.Duration].

nodes.Name: GroupValue
nodes.DocComment:
GroupValue returns a new [Value] for a list of Attrs.
The caller must not subsequently mutate the argument slice.

nodes.Name: countEmptyGroups
nodes.DocComment: countEmptyGroups returns the number of empty group values in its argument.

nodes.Name: AnyValue
nodes.DocComment:
AnyValue returns a [Value] for the supplied value.

If the supplied value is of type Value, it is returned
unmodified.

Given a value of one of Go's predeclared string, bool, or
(non-complex) numeric types, AnyValue returns a Value of kind
[KindString], [KindBool], [KindUint64], [KindInt64], or [KindFloat64].
The width of the original numeric type is not preserved.

Given a [time.Time] or [time.Duration] value, AnyValue returns a Value of kind
[KindTime] or [KindDuration]. The monotonic time is not preserved.

For nil, or values of all other types, including named types whose
underlying type is numeric, AnyValue returns a value of kind [KindAny].

nodes.Name: Any
nodes.DocComment: Any returns v's value as an any.

nodes.Name: String
nodes.DocComment:
String returns Value's value as a string, formatted like [fmt.Sprint]. Unlike
the methods Int64, Float64, and so on, which panic if v is of the
wrong kind, String never panics.

nodes.Name: Int64
nodes.DocComment:
Int64 returns v's value as an int64. It panics
if v is not a signed integer.

nodes.Name: Uint64
nodes.DocComment:
Uint64 returns v's value as a uint64. It panics
if v is not an unsigned integer.

nodes.Name: Bool
nodes.DocComment:
Bool returns v's value as a bool. It panics
if v is not a bool.

nodes.Name: Duration
nodes.DocComment:
Duration returns v's value as a [time.Duration]. It panics
if v is not a time.Duration.

nodes.Name: Float64
nodes.DocComment:
Float64 returns v's value as a float64. It panics
if v is not a float64.

nodes.Name: Time
nodes.DocComment:
Time returns v's value as a [time.Time]. It panics
if v is not a time.Time.

nodes.Name: time
nodes.DocComment: See TimeValue to understand how times are represented.

nodes.Name: LogValuer
nodes.DocComment:
LogValuer returns v's value as a LogValuer. It panics
if v is not a LogValuer.

nodes.Name: Group
nodes.DocComment:
Group returns v's value as a []Attr.
It panics if v's [Kind] is not [KindGroup].

nodes.Name: Equal
nodes.DocComment: Equal reports whether v and w represent the same Go value.

nodes.Name: isEmptyGroup
nodes.DocComment: isEmptyGroup reports whether v is a group that has no attributes.

nodes.Name: append
nodes.DocComment:
append appends a text representation of v to dst.
v is formatted as with fmt.Sprint.

nodes.Name: LogValuer
nodes.DocComment:
A LogValuer is any Go value that can convert itself into a Value for logging.

This mechanism may be used to defer expensive operations until they are
needed, or to expand a single value into a sequence of components.

nodes.Name: Resolve
nodes.DocComment:
Resolve repeatedly calls LogValue on v while it implements [LogValuer],
and returns the result.
If v resolves to a group, the group's attributes' values are not recursively
resolved.
If the number of LogValue calls exceeds a threshold, a Value containing an
error is returned.
Resolve's return value is guaranteed not to be of Kind [KindLogValuer].
